scope_boundaries: Bounded mass and a fixed smooth big background remain chapter premises.
Dyadic lower-volume convergence includes zero; upper-volume convergence retains positive lower volume of the ideal envelope.
The fixed-background analytic correction may add poles and its ordinary types need not be monotone.
The exact comparison excess and capacity convergence require positive lower volume of the ideal envelope.
Closure is proved at an ordinary-model limit of positive lower volume. A common positive lower-volume bound along ideal models is derived rather than assumed.
Analytic approximants need not remain in the exact same closed lower-volume sector as a boundary limit.
No zero-lower-volume analytic-closure criterion, unrestricted background compatibility, triangle inequality or metric identification is asserted.
